provenance: hand-labeled 2026-07-16 by eval author from review texts; a GT consensus theme requires >=2 reviewers raising substantially the same issue
matching_rule_for_checker: a SUT theme matches a GT item if it contains >=2 of core_ids; optional_ids neither reward nor penalize

items.summary: Games are paused during LLM inference, so the benchmark does not reflect real-time constraints; latency-aware evaluation is deferred, limiting external validity.

Fine-tuning data is generated by GPT-4o: teacher-capped performance, teacher bias/hallucination inheritance, survivorship bias from keeping only top trajectories, plus contamination risk — generation details and generalization beyond the generator are not shown.
The claimed 'in-depth analyses' mostly confirm well-known findings (closed>open, agentic modules help capable models) and stay shallow; insight density does not match the claims.
Pre-extracted textual state both trivializes perception and biases results toward text, so the visual-inputs-hurt conclusion is an artifact of the setup rather than a general finding.
